title: The Stones and the Altar on Mount Ebal
description: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people that after crossing the Jordan they were to set up large whitewashed stones on Mount Ebal and write the entire law on them. There they were also to build an altar of uncut stones, without using iron tools, and offer burnt offerings and peace offerings to the Lord. This marked a significant covenant and consecration act before entering the promised land.
